title: Villain Hour
description: Villain Open Mic on Snazzie FM. Four callers, each convinced they run the city. Gary just makes noises at them.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight, it got dangerous. It's Villain Open Mic. If you have a scheme, the lines are open.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I want it noted that I was against this segment.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Noted and ignored, Barry. Winston, you're up first.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Thank you, Ronnie. As I was saying, before this rabble arrived. I control the entire city. Every traffic light. Every bus.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Yeah, well, the pigeons are MINE, Winston! You think you run the city? The PIGEONS run the city!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Oh, here we go. The bird man.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Do not call me the bird man, Winston!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Okay, okay, you are BOTH broke. <p:0.3> Real power is on the blockchain, gentlemen.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Nobody asked the child.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: I am a FOUNDER, Winston!

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Blah, blah, blah. <p:0.3> Listen to you all. Ooh, I run the city. Ooh, I have pigeons.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Who is that?

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: It's Gary. And you are all clowns. Wah, wah, wah.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Gary, please do not make the noises.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: I'll make whatever noises I want, Barry. <p:0.3> Pbbbt.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Let's keep it civil, gentlemen. There's room for many villains.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: There is NOT room. The city is mine. Singular.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Through the PIGEONS, which are mine!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: You can tokenize the pigeons! <p:0.3> I'll do it right now! PigeonCoin two!

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Oh, here he goes again. PigeonCoin. <p:0.3> My pension is already in the first one, you little crook.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It's a healthy dip, Gary!

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: It's a CRATER, Chad!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, they are all yelling. I can't tell who the villain is anymore.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's the beauty of it, Barry. Tonight, they all are.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: I am the PRIMARY villain!

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Pigeons!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Crypto!

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Clowns! <p:0.2> Every one of you. Honk honk.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Did he just honk?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He honked, Barry. <p:0.3> And honestly? That's the most coherent argument we've heard all night.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: I will NOT be honked at!

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Honk.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: STOP HONKING AT ME!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're gonna take a break before this becomes a circus. <p:0.3> Too late. It's a circus. Stay tuned.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm leaving. I mean it this time.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Honk honk, Barry.
